name: Working with Pi Coding Agents - KDnuggets
description: The most interesting thing about Pi isn't any single feature; it's that the project treats "what we didn't build" as documentation worth writing, which is rare enough on its own to take seriously. By Shittu Olumide, Technical Content Specialist on July 16, 2026 in Programming · Most coding agents compete on how much they do for you. Claude Code manages sub-agents, plan mode, and permission flows out of the box.
